a.lede: Microsoft has resolved a bug that caused games and apps using AC-3 (Dolby Digital) audio decoding to crash after installing the September 2026 Windows 11 preview update (KB5124010). [...]
a.title: Microsoft fixes game, app crashes caused by recent Windows update

b.lede: A bug in Microsoft’s October Windows update prevents you from turning on a security setting that blocks malicious or suspicious apps. A Registry hack fixes the glitch.
b.title: Latest Windows update disables key security setting – but there’s a workaround
